 Shillong Teer Result Today, November 5, 2026: How To Check Results? Check Timings, Prizes, All Details
 News oi-Pooja Jaiswar By Pooja Jaiswar 
 Published: Thursday, November 5, 2026, 15:20 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google Shillong Teer Result Today, November 5, 2026: There are several lotteries and games carried out by northern states, and one of them is Shillong Teer, which is one of the most popular and oldest archery-based games in the Meghalaya state. The game's results are announced in two rounds from the iconic Polo Ground in Shillong. The first round was announced at 3.45 pm of November 5, with the winning number being 20. The second round has also been announced.
 What Is Shillong Teer?
 Shillong Teer is the best known of all teer games. It is held in Shillong, the capital of Meghalaya, where archers from the Khasi Hills shoot at a target at the Polo Ground in two rounds on each draw day. The arrows that strike the target are counted, and the last two digits of the count become the first round (FR) number and then the second round (SR) number. Alongside the main afternoon draw, Shillong Morning Teer, Shillong Night Teer and Night Teer declare their own FR and SR results, and the Shillong Teer result today for each of them is tracked here.
 Shillong Teer Results Today 3:45 PM: First Round Winning Number
 Shillong Teer Results Today, 4:45 PM: Second Round Winning Number
 On November 5, 2026, the first and second round results include for Shillong Teer, Shillong Morning Teer, Shillong Night Teer and Night Teer.
 Scheduled times: Shillong Teer FR at 4:15 PM and SR at 5:10 PM; Shillong Morning Teer FR at 10:30 AM and SR at 11:00 AM; Shillong Night Teer FR at 8:00 PM and SR at 9:00 PM; Night Teer FR at 11:10 PM and SR at 12:10 AM (next day).
 How Shillong Teer works?
 Each game day, a group of trained archers shoot a fixed number of arrows at a cylindrical wooden target placed at a regulated distance. Officials count the total number of successful arrow hits after each round. The last two digits of this hit count become the officially declared result number for that round, known as FR (First Round) and SR (Second Round), as per Instant Teer Results website.
 Shillong Teer Results Today: How To Participate?
 Players purchase numbered tickets (00-99) from licensed Teer counters before each round. If the ticket number matches the declared FR or SR result, the ticket holder wins the corresponding prize. Ticket counters operate from early morning until approximately 15 minutes before each round begins. Only licensed Teer counters are legally permitted to sell tickets under the Meghalaya Amusements Act, according to the website.
 The prizes vary in Shillong Teer.
